page.layout: One page of running text, with a marginal note in the left margin beside the first paragraph. Running head at the top; catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Propoma absinthites, cinnamomites.quæ maxime commendantur, quæ exabsin-thio & aromatibus conficiuntur. In frequentissimo hodie usu est propoma absinthites, quod ut Trallianus testatur vim habet stomachum corroborandi, extenuandi, expellendique excrementa in eo contenta.

Cinnamomites quoq; propoma vires insignes obtinet in corroborando cerebro & corde. Panis similiter buccella cum melle, cydoniaq; cocta ebrietati resistunt potenter. Plinius adversus ebrietatem & tremulentiam valere pecudum pulmonem allum præsumtum: inprimis vero apri, suis achœdi: hirundinis rostri cinerem cum myrrha tritum, & in vinum bibendum infperfum l. 30.c.15.testatur, huiusq; remedii inventoré [?] effe Horum Assyriorum Regem. Adversus idem & iaspidem pollere affirmant, sed incerto experimento. Ipsam vero ebrietatem discutere ne sentiatur, porrum sectiuum [?], aut crocum prius potum apud claros autores invenio. Sed melilotus multorum etiam antiquissimorum consensu celebratur. Alii radiculam commendant elixam, quod restatur Alexis,

p.i: Iam vero nonne omnium malorum est ebrietas Maximum hominibus & nocentissimum, Heri subbibisti, ideo nunc crapula vexaris, Obdormito, ac lenaberis, deinde tibi det Radiculam quis elixam.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Doubtful readings: "inventoré" (accent over final e uncertain); "porrum sectiuum" (word after "sectiuum" uncertain, possibly "fectiuum"); "30.c.15." (first digit could be 5); "Adversus idem" line partly unclear. Catchword "Sed" at lower right. Left marginal note in italic, attached to the first paragraph. The page number 616 is printed at the head, and the running head is "De Vita".
